server.port.description: UDP port on which the OpenVPN server listens for incoming connections.

server.network.description: VPN subnet network address (e.g., '10.8.0.0'). Clients will be assigned IPs in this range.

server.netmask.description: Subnet mask for the VPN network (e.g., '255.255.255.0').

server.cert_name.description: Common name (CN) of the server certificate (must match the filename in Easy-RSA).

server.cipher.description: Encryption cipher used for VPN traffic (e.g., 'AES-256-GCM', 'AES-128-CBC').

server.auth.description: HMAC authentication algorithm for packet integrity (e.g., 'SHA256', 'SHA1').

server.allow_duplicate_cn.description: Whether to allow multiple clients with the same certificate common name (use with caution).

server.push_routes.description: List of internal networks to route to VPN clients (e.g., local subnet access).

server.push_dns.description: Whether to push DNS settings to clients (e.g., to use internal DNS servers or public DNS).

server.dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers to push to clients (e.g., ['1.1.1.1', '9.9.9.9']).

server.ldap.enabled.description: Enable LDAP authentication via PAM plugin. Requires openvpn-plugin-auth-pam.so and ldap.conf.

server.client_options.description: Client-specific configuration overrides (e.g., static IPs or access controls).

ip.description: Static IP to assign to this client (must be within server network, e.g., '10.8.0.10').

block.description: If true, disables client-connect script that may be used for access control.
